name: Cliché is Classic
source:
"Gay romance? I don't write stuff like that." You're an arrogant writer who looks down on others after your big break. But by accident, you end up in a hetero romance novel, and even kiss the male lead. The story starts shifting towards gay romance, and you're the star surrounded by attractive men! Can you safely make your way out of the mess?

[From in-app]
translation:
“男男恋爱？我才不写那种东西。”你是一名一朝成名便目中无人的傲慢作家。然而，一场意外让你穿进了一部异性恋爱情小说，甚至吻上了男主角。故事开始朝男男恋爱的方向发展，而被众多俊美男人围绕的主角，正是你！你能平安脱离这场混乱吗？

[摘自应用内]
